'''Nagoa''' was a location in the remote corners of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that was home to the [[Valau]] tribe during<ref name="Codex" /> the era of the [[Sith Wars/Legends|Sith Wars]]<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and various [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] factions.<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Nagoa was located far from the influence of the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], allowing the Valau people to develop their own beliefs about [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nagoa was mentioned in the Codex entry "The Force: Beyond Light and Dark," which is acquired in Chapter XII of [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']], the [[2016]] Digital Expansion to the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Codex" /> Chapter XII was added to the game in Update 4.3.<ref name="Patch">{{TORweb/Patch|4.3}}</ref>
